Welcome to the pre-course Q&A session for the data science for openwashdata course! This session was held before the official start of the course to address questions about the course content, logistics, and expectations.

## {{< fa video >}} Session Recording

You can access the Zoom recording of our live Q&A session held on August 26th, 2025 at 1 pm CET.

*Note: The video link will be shared once the recording is available.*

## {{< fa calendar >}} Event Details

For more information about the Q&A session, including the original event announcement and schedule, visit the [event page](https://openwashdata.org/pages/events/2025-08-26-ds4owd-qa/).

## {{< fa file-lines >}} Shared Notes

During the session, we used a collaborative Google Doc to capture questions and answers. Access the [Google Doc with shared notes](https://openwashdata.org/pages/events/2025-08-26-ds4owd-qa/#google-doc-notes) from our Q&A session.

## {{< fa question-circle >}} Key Topics Covered

During the Q&A session, we discussed:

- Course prerequisites and technical requirements
- Time commitment and course schedule
- Capstone project expectations
- GitHub setup and collaboration

## {{< fa arrow-right >}} Next Steps

After reviewing this Q&A session:

1. Complete the [pre-course survey]({{< var platforms.pre-course-survey >}}) if you haven't already
2. Join the course [Posit Cloud workspace]({{< var platforms.posit-cloud >}})
3. Set up your GitHub account
4. Join the course communication channels (Element/Matrix)
5. Get ready for [Module 1](md-01.qmd) starting on {{< var md-01.date >}}

## {{< fa comments >}} Questions?

If you have additional questions after watching the recording:

- Post in the course Element/Matrix chat

- Bring your questions to Module 1
